description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribath Kumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552 (22/0783)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership information, and legal encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes, which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related adjudications. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the specialized nature of land registration makes it distinct from other specialized categories.
